title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.191.0
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and ship parity fixes and a coordinated version bump to v1.191.0. This PR centralizes previously divergent retry semantics, standardizes streaming callback/async interfaces, and fixes parity gaps discovered during cross-language integration tests. Scope: 1) auth: unifies token refresh hooks and deterministic header order for signing; 2) retries: aligns default retry/backoff config and surface area (per-call vs client-level) and documents behavior; 3) streaming: provides consistent async iterator (Python), ReadableStream wrapper (TS), and channel interface (Go) with identical cancel/signal semantics; 4) ergonomics: small API renames for clarity (stream.close -> stream.cancel where applicable), improved type hints and docstrings; 5) parity fixes: fixed edge-case decoding mismatch for chunked events, aligned error codes and structured error payloads; 6) version bump: coordinated package versions bumped to v1.191.0 for py/ts/go and release notes prepared. Commits summary:  - 6 commits: initial unify patches, python streaming iterator, ts ReadableStream wrapper, go channel adapter, retry policy centralization, docs and changelog. Changed areas (high level): sdk/python/redwood_sdk/__init__.py, sdk/python/redwood_sdk/stream.py, sdk/python/tests/test_stream_integration.py, sdk/typescript/src/streaming.ts, sdk/typescript/src/auth.ts, sdk/typescript/package.json, sdk/go/redwood/sdk/stream.go, sdk/go/redwood/sdk/retry.go, shared/docs/sdk-auth-retries.md, shared/CHANGELOG.md, build/sdks/version-bump.yaml, tests/integration/cross_lang_parity.yaml. Testing: all unit test suites run locally; added cross-language integration harness and parity test matrix with Python/TS/Go end-to-end checks. CI: initial run had lint failures in TS (prettier) which were fixed in follow-up commit; full CI green on merge. Reviews: requested API ergonomics feedback from Marco and Lena; Samir reviewed Go concurrency semantics. Backwards compatibility: kept old constructor overloads as deprecated shims for one release; documented migration steps in shared/docs/sdk-auth-retries.md. Rollout: release coordinated with package pipelines and internal SDK consumers; feature flags not required since changes are opt-in by bumping the client library. Release notes included below. Checklist: [x] unit tests added/updated [x] integration parity tests [x] docs updated [x] changelog updated [x] version bump [x] reviewers approved.
commits: initial: centralize retry policy and common types
python: add async streaming iterator and cancel semantics
typescript: add ReadableStream adapter and standardize auth hook
go: add channel-based streaming adapter and align retry logic
fix: address TS linting and type issues
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Nice consolidation. One nit: consider exposing a client-level retry_policy as an object for advanced users.
Ava Thompson: responded, added client-level RetryPolicy class and updated docs with examples.
Lena Chen: Approved after docs update. Left a suggestion to make stream.cancel idempotent.
Samir Singh: Found a potential race in Go stream close; added a small mutex around close path and added test.
release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.191.0: Unify auth token hooks, align retry/backoff semantics, add consistent streaming ergonomics across languages, parity fixes for chunked event decoding, API ergonomics improvements and migration docs. Note: deprecated legacy overloads will be removed in v1.193.0; see migration guide.
notes: This was a cross-SDK coordination PR. Consumers should upgrade all three SDKs together when relying on streaming cancellation semantics or retry defaults. Internal SDK consumers were notified via #sdk-updates Slack channel and a staging rollout was performed before publishing to public registries.
